sandbox.notes: Prodigi Sandbox: 'Sandbox API: api.sandbox.prodigi.com' (Environments section; paths are the same /v4.0 ones). Orders placed there are not fulfilled or charged. A Live dashboard account gets a Sandbox account automatically; use the Sandbox API key (sandbox dashboard sandbox-beta-dashboard.pwinty.com).

fields.name: api_key
fields.help: Prodigi API key for the LIVE environment (dashboard), sent as `X-API-Key`. A Sandbox key needs PLATFORM_MCP_PRODIGI_ART_ENV=sandbox (https://api.sandbox.prodigi.com/v4.0).

me.note: Prodigi has no account endpoint; the probe lists one order (GET /v4.0/Orders?top=1).

get_product.note: `id` is the Prodigi SKU (e.g. GLOBAL-CAN-10X10); productDimensions, attributes, printAreas and variants[] are in `raw`. Prices come from POST /quotes, not from the product.

create_order.note: Spends money on the live account. `shipping_address` is Prodigi's recipient {name, email, phoneNumber, address{line1, line2, postalOrZipCode, countryCode, townOrCity, stateOrCounty}}; `items` are Prodigi items [{sku, copies, sizing, attributes, assets[{printArea, url}]}]; `shipping_option` is the required shippingMethod (Budget|Standard|Express|Overnight).

get_order.note: status.stage is one of the order stages (InProgress, Complete, ...); charges[] and shipments[{carrier, tracking{number, url}}] are in `raw`.

quote_shipping.note: POST /v4.0/quotes for one SKU (product_id) with `quantity` copies and a single 'default' print area, shipped to `country` (ISO-2). No shippingMethod is sent, so Prodigi quotes each available method: quotes[{shipmentMethod, costSummary{items, shipping} (decimal strings), shipments}]. SKUs whose attributes are mandatory (e.g. canvas wrap) or that need other print areas are rejected by Prodigi, since the vocabulary cannot pass attributes.

not_offered.list_products: No catalogue browse endpoint: products are SKUs chosen in the Prodigi dashboard; GET /v4.0/products/{sku} only reads one.
not_offered.track: No tracking-events endpoint; shipments[{carrier{name, service}, tracking{number, url}}] are part of the order record (see get_order).
